summary: MSc Data Science student at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg with hands-on experience turning large language models (LLMs) into a working application: prompt design and iteration, embedding-based retrieval, deployment to managed endpoints, and the evaluation loops that show whether a change improved output quality. Built an ATS Resume Checker on Google Vertex AI that parses documents, scores them against a reference and returns structured feedback. Delivered 10+ production-ready models during an AI and ML internship recognised as Best Performer, with Python and Git across every role. Available as a working student: up to 20 h/week during the semester, full time during official semester breaks.

bullets: Recognised as Best Performer of the cohort: completed 8 end-to-end machine learning projects and delivered 10+ production-ready models in Python across the supervised and unsupervised spectrum.

Selected and reported the evaluation metric that fitted each problem: 95%+ ROC-AUC on a Support Vector Machine tuned by GridSearchCV hyperparameter search, 96%+ accuracy on breast-cancer diagnosis with Logistic Regression, R² above 0.90 on housing-price regression.
Built a Walmart weekly-sales forecasting model with XGBoost, reaching 96.1% R² and reducing forecast error by 18%.
Segmented 200 customers into five actionable clusters with K-Means at a silhouette score of 0.55.

Built an ATS Resume Checker powered by large language models: parsing resumes, scoring them against job descriptions and returning structured feedback, an automated document-analysis workflow end to end.
Designed and iterated LLM prompts and embedding-based retrieval on Google Vertex AI, grounding the output so the scoring stayed consistent enough to act on.
Deployed the application against Vertex AI managed endpoints and set up evaluation loops to measure and improve output quality after release.
Operated and supported VMware virtualisation infrastructure and set up monitoring for cloud workloads.
Automated recurring infrastructure tasks and enforced security guidelines across managed environments.
Built an American Sign Language image-recognition system with a Convolutional Neural Network in PyTorch.
Implemented the full training, validation and inference pipeline, including data augmentation to improve generalisation.

publications.description: Final-year thesis project: deep-learning surveillance on live CCTV feeds, reporting 95.79% mAP@0.5 for weapon detection and 93.75% accuracy for face recognition. Led as team leader; personally optimised the object-detection model for real-time inference on standard hardware, integrated the face-recognition pipeline with privacy and ethical considerations in the design, and tuned the system to cut false alarms while holding accuracy. Awarded Best Paper at ICISD 2025.
